Done — passed on the first execution.

**Approach** (`out/T2/plan.yaml`, 270 lines): for each of the 16 layers, four groups of transforms. For q/k/v: `copy` the source with row slices `[:640, :]` and `[768:, :]` into temporaries, `delete` the original, `concat` the two temps back under the original name on `dim: 0`. For o_proj the same with column slices `[:, :640]` / `[:, 768:]` and `dim: 1`. A final `delete: tmp_.*` cleans up, followed by the four `assert: shape` checks and `assert: count {of: '.*', is: 114}`, then output to `out/T2/model.safetensors`.

The plan had to be written out explicitly per tensor because `concat` needs each source to resolve to exactly one tensor and a single literal destination — it does not take capture-group rewrites the way `copy`'s `to` does.

**Verification**: output has 114 tensors, float32; q/k/v are `[1920, 2048]`, o_proj `[2048, 1920]`; spot-checked layer 7 q_proj and o_proj plus `model.embed_tokens.weight` as bit-exact against the expected concatenation of the input shards. Self-report written to `out/T2/REPORT.md`.
